meta.title: Casa Terra Mare | Private Pool Stay
meta.description: Casa Terra Mare is a private pool retreat with warm stone architecture, calm rooms, and generous outdoor spaces.

hero.title: Casa Terra Mare
hero.copy: A warm stone hideaway designed for slow mornings, poolside afternoons, and restful nights.

intro.title: A calm retreat made for gathering, resting, and enjoying the water.
intro.copy: Casa Terra Mare brings together sunlit interiors, a private pool, quiet bedrooms, and open-air corners for breakfast, conversation, and long evening meals.

main.title: Main Bedroom
main.copy: A bright, simple bedroom for deep rest after a day by the pool.

kitchen.title: Kitchen & Living
kitchen.copy: Open spaces for cooking, coffee, and relaxed time together.

guest.title: Guest Rooms
guest.copy: Flexible rooms that make the house easy for couples, friends, or family.

experiences.title: Pool Days, Shared Meals, Quiet Evenings

pool.title: Poolside Afternoons
pool.copy: Cool off, stretch out in the sun, and keep the whole day wonderfully unhurried.

outdoor.title: Outdoor Living
outdoor.copy: Stone walls, shaded corners, and open spaces make the outside feel like the main room.

comfort.title: Simple Comforts
comfort.copy: Everything is arranged for an easy stay: practical, comfortable, and welcoming.

quote.text: "A peaceful house with everything close at hand: the pool, the rooms, the kitchen, and the sunny places to sit."
quote.author: Casa Terra Mare guest
